sentences.text:
Shri A.N. Tiwari, learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/
State.
Heard on the question of admission.
The revision is admitted for hearing.
Also heard on I.A.No.6917/2017 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The applicant has been convicted for commission of offence punishable under Sec. 7(I) Rule r/w Sec. 16(1)(A)(I) and Sec. 7(iii) r/w 16(1)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 6 months and fine of Rs.1000/-, in default of payment of fine amount, he is further sentenced to R.I. for one month, each.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that during trial and during pendency of the appeal, the applicant was on bail.

Considering the short sentence awarded by the trial Court, looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, I.A.No.6917/2017 is allowed and subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, sentence of applicant is hereby suspended.

It is directed that on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand), along with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, the applicant-Mahesh be released on bail for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 10.7.2017, and on such other future dates as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard,
till disposal of the revision.
